from fastapi import FastAPI

from app.routers.health import router as health_router
from app.routers.meta import router as meta_router


def create_app() -> FastAPI:
    application = FastAPI(title="Inventory API", version="0.1.0")
    application.include_router(health_router)
    application.include_router(meta_router)
    return application


app = create_app()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


def test_liveness(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.get("/health/live")

    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["status"] == "ok"

from pydantic import BaseModel


class HealthResponse(BaseModel):
    status: str
    checks: dict[str, str]

workspace: .

llm:
  provider: openai
  model: deterministic-demo
  max_output_tokens: 1000
  store_responses: false

permissions:
  read:
    deny: [".env", ".env.*", "**/*.pem", "**/*.key", "secrets/**", ".git/**"]
  write:
    deny: [".env", ".env.*", ".git/**", ".github/**", "**/*.lock", "secrets/**"]

commands:
  deny: ["rm -rf", "git push", "git reset --hard", "sudo"]
  require_approval: ["python -m pip install", "pip install", "git commit"]
  allow_by_role:
    explorer: ["ls", "find", "rg"]
    researcher: []
    implementer: []
    tester: ["python -m pytest", "python -m compileall"]
    reviewer: []

execution:
  timeout_seconds: 20
  max_output_chars: 20000
  max_read_bytes: 200000
  max_list_entries: 500
  max_agent_iterations: 10
  max_identical_actions: 2
  max_identical_failures: 2

rag:
  enabled: true
  collection_name: demo-fastapi
  collection_version: "2026-07-14"
  persistence_path: ./data/vector_store
  embedding_model: deterministic-fake-v1
  embedding_dimension: 64
  chunk_size_tokens: 300
  chunk_overlap_tokens: 40
  top_k: 4
  minimum_relevance: 0.2
  web_fallback: true
  allowed_url_domains: ["fastapi.tiangolo.com", "docs.pydantic.dev", "docs.pytest.org"]

memory:
  enabled: true
  database_path: ./data/memory.sqlite3

  enabled: false
  redact_sensitive_data: true
